conflicts: Ionization energy: ISOLDE 67896.310(14)(30) cm^-1 (Fink et al. 2019) and TRIUMF 67896.33(3)(12) cm^-1 agree; both are 36 cm^-1 above the older literature value 67860(30) cm^-1 (Sansonetti et al., as listed in Table 2 of Fink et al. 2019), which NIST has since replaced.
218Po isotope shift on the 843 nm line: -11524(125) MHz (RILIS, Cocolios 2011) vs -11406(150) MHz (LIST, Fink 2015); consistent within errors.

Nuclear moments: the values in the isotopes block are the 2024 re-evaluation (Skripnikov & Barzakh); the original papers (Seliverstov 2014, Fink 2015) gave mu(207Po) = 0.793(55), mu(211Po) = -1.197(30){85}, Q(211Po) = -0.77(8){15} b, i.e. quadrupole moments about 20 % smaller.
217Po: spin 9/2 or 11/2 not decided; constants for both fits are in the source strings.
not_found: radiative lifetimes of the 6p3 7s 5S°2 (39081.19) and 3S°1 (40802.70) levels: no measurement found; NIST has no transition probabilities for Po I
transition probabilities / branching ratios of the 245.0, 255.8, 300.4, 417.2 nm lines the site draws: none found
hyperfine constants of the 6p4 3P1, 1D2 and 6p3 7s 3S°1 levels: none found

isotope shifts and hyperfine constants on the 255.8 nm line (Kowalewska et al., Phys. Rev. A 44, R1442 (1991)): paper is not open access; only the 207Po and 209Po 5S2 constants quoted second-hand were recovered
odd-A isotope shifts of 191-211Po (Seliverstov et al., Phys. Lett. B 719, 362 (2013)): not opened
ground-state hyperfine constants from the atomic-beam work of Olsmats et al. 1961: original not opened; only the ratio to the 5S2 constants is given here
notes: All optical data are from in-source resonance ionization spectroscopy at ISOLDE (Doppler-limited, GHz linewidths). Isotope shifts are nu(A) - nu(210). Hyperfine keys: 'ls'/'hs' = low-spin (3/2-) and high-spin (13/2+) states of 193,195Po whose ordering is not known; a trailing 'm' = 13/2+ isomer. The hyperfine constants listed under the 39081.19 cm^-1 level were printed in GHz and are converted to MHz here. The site's default isotope may have I = 0 (208, 210Po) - then no hyperfine structure applies.
